summary: user options: append to groups (required with groups since 2.21), Solaris authorization, comment/GECOS, create_home, expires epoch (negative removes), and force deletion.
questions: How do I add a user to a group without removing other groups?
How do I set an account expiry date?
How do I remove an account expiry?
How do I set the full name of a user?
Do I need append when using groups in newer Ansible?

answer_card.title: user parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `append` (false): true adds to `groups`; false makes `groups` the exact list. **Required with `groups` since 2.21.**
- `comment`: GECOS
- `create_home` (true)
- `expires`: epoch time; negative removes expiry (Linux/FreeBSD)
- `force`: like `userdel --force` (with absent); overwrites SSH key with `generate_ssh_key`
- `authorization`: Solaris only
